acceptance: Digital prototype design review. Physical electrical, thermal, runtime and wearing qualification is unmeasured; this record is not physical acceptance for wearing an untested assembly.
authority: Bryan requested a module prototype, identified the over-broad digital qualification contract, and authorized doing everything possible on the issue/PR on 2026-11-04. Preserve the original approved spec and rejected-circuit history.

S1.part: C&K 7201SYZQE, DPDT ON-ON, 5 A at 28 VDC

LATCH.part: Pololu 2808 Mini Pushbutton Power Switch LV

C_OUT.part: Panasonic EEUFR1A102, 1000 uF 10 V +/-20%, 10 x 16 mm body

SPARKLE.part: Adafruit Sparkle Motion, board revision D

IMU.part: Existing 3.3 V IMU placeholder; exact board remains unresolved

RING1.part: Existing 120 pixel/m strip; exact stock remains unresolved

RING2.part: Existing 120 pixel/m strip; exact stock remains unresolved

RING3.part: Existing 120 pixel/m strip; exact stock remains unresolved

wiring.main: M22759/16-18-2 and M22759/16-18-0, 18 AWG; fixed soldered joints, insulated and strain-relieved
wiring.branches: M22759/16-22-2 and M22759/16-22-0, 22 AWG; individual LED 1 A and auxiliary 0.5 A branch fuses
wiring.sense: 100 kohm/100 kohm divider from B to PA4; no raw-cell reporting bypass
wiring.routing: Place F1 at positive contact; insulate the unfused tail and both contact backs. Route paired supply/return; protect every fuse and solder joint. No raw-cell plug or external battery entry.

operating_plan.cell_v_kind: Declared normal operating range; nominal module LBI trip is about 3.2 V, not a guaranteed trip envelope.
operating_plan.basis: Initial bench configuration only. Verify 2% electrical brightness and the 2 W non-LED allowance before operation. No firmware ceiling or safe current limit is claimed; higher brightness needs another load review. Enclosed temperatures and current transients are unmeasured.

service.instruction: Support, physical OFF, disconnect USB, then wait for the measured service dwell before opening. The dwell remains unset until a decay test. Insert one protected XTAR cell to the polarity marks, latch the door, select ON and press the on-only START button. Navigation/radio readiness is not established by light output.
service.usb: Remove the cell, keep S1 OFF, use USB 5 V off-body. No barrel supply or other live interface at the same time. PowerBoost USB-A and battery JST are not installed; do not charge the cell in the pendant.

open_design_items.detail: Select the exact IMU and 120 pixel/m strip stock and verify input/pin limits, loaded envelopes and branch demand. Existing placeholders are not construction-ready parts.
Complete the BlackPill/Sparkle/GPS/IMU/radio signal pin map, power order and radio duty-cycle budget; verify the 500 mA peak external 3.3 V limit. No new firmware or diagnostics are assumed.
Derive both installed wire cut lists and strain relief/envelopes from the new compartment/module layout. Current wire gauges alone do not complete routing.

startup_and_pulses.procedure: Measure boost input/output, battery current and radio/PWM/inrush on both assemblies across the declared cell range; no reset, trip or out-of-rating pin transient during normal use.

latch_and_rebound.procedure: Measure BOOST.R20.2 and LATCH.OFF amplitude/duration. Low battery must switch B off; voltage rebound must not restart it. Repeat with bounce, slow depletion and a fast supply drop. Record power-loss defaults separately.

off_and_replacement.procedure: With S1 OFF and USB absent, verify both switch poles disconnect, all load/control rails decay and START has no effect. Measure decay before accepting any service dwell; repeat warm/rapid replacement.

short_and_reversal.procedure: Use controlled laboratory fault testing to verify reversal, overload/short interruption, cell PCM recovery and fuse/harness/contact withstand. Do not deliberately short an unprotected loose cell.

thermal.procedure: Measure cell, boost, latch, contacts, wires and front/rear touch temperatures in both closed enclosures at the stated ambient/load and wearing conditions, including warm recovery.

runtime.procedure: Measure usable energy and runtime at the named rainbow settings; compare with the model. No four-hour guarantee.

fit_and_worn_mass.procedure: Measure cell/holder contacts, retention/access and complete installed cell plus necklace mass. Digital geometry and estimated mass do not establish physical acceptance.

historical_recovery: electrical-review.md and the original electrical-*.json studies remain rejected custom-circuit evidence. Their counters/findings are not reset. They do not describe this module prototype.
